# G10 market notes for carry and roll-down

Verify conventions in [fi-g10-market-conventions](../../fi-g10-market-conventions/SKILL.md) before quoting. Figures are as of the cited date and
are examples of scale, not current data.

| Market | Carry/roll specifics | Evidence (source, date) |
|---|---|---|
| USD | Term repo rarely beyond about 3m, so long-dated forwards are cheaper to express as SOFR swaps: a long financed 5y UST ~ receive 5y swap / pay o/n SOFR. UST carry needs per-issue repo and a spline for roll; swaps need neither. Futures carry uses bond-specific term repo to delivery. SR3 is compounded (Act/360), SR1 a simple average; roll SR3 2nd into 3rd. 2024: every UST beyond bills negative carry vs money-market yields (2y 4.53% vs 5.35%). Repo day count Act/360. | BofA UST RV Primer (2 May 2022); BofA Rates basics (15 Feb 2024); Huggins and Schaller (2022); Bassman, The Cost of Carry (5 Mar 2024) |
| USD front end | 2y swap minus EFFR averaged about 74bp since 1994, about 62bp post-GFC; the forward spread inverts before cuts with a lag (Jul 2006 -> Sep 2007). 17 Jun 2019: 2y 1.858% vs EFFR 2.375%, 6m-forward 2y 1.696% (16.2bp below spot): paying it earns roll-up carry of 31c, a 6m payer on 2y costs about 46c. | Bassman, For Propeller Heads Only (17 Jun 2019) |
| USD long end | Forward curve beyond 20y held steep by variable-annuity and life-insurer receiving in 15-25y; forward strip humps near 10y so belly roll is term-premium; implied above realised on long forwards. Receive below the hump, pay above. | Citi Rates Vol Lab (9 May 2019) |
| EUR | Term-index legs: fixing shortcut with alpha 0.5 (6m Euribor). Forward curve top near a 15y start; 1y forwards roll positive to about 15y (max about 13bp near 6-8y) and negative beyond (min about -5bp near 21y), forwards starting beyond about 41y negative. 2y1y EUR RFR trades at the market-implied neutral rate and rolled 25bp in a year (19 Jun 2025). Front-end flies show large roll in cutting cycles. Dutch pension year-end receiving is a seasonal risk to carry positions. EGB repo is issuer-specific (GC by country); haircut risk is the carry risk for periphery. Forward par curve about 4-6.5bp above spot over 6m in 2018: steepeners positive roll. | Nordea Flash (24 Jan, 5 Feb, 17 Mar 2020); Nordea (19 Jun 2025, 26 Sep 2025); Duering (2021); Tuckman and Serrat (2022) |
| EUR long end | Structurally negative forward-spot roll in the long end; EUR 10y10y/15y15y carry -6.31, BE/RV 1.44 (expensive convexity, Sep 2019); 5y5y/15y5y/25y5y fly (pay 15y5y) earned 30.9bp/yr since 2022, 26.9bp via negative 1m forward-spot roll. | Citi Vol Lab (25 Sep 2019); Citi European Rates Weekly (24 Sep 2026) |
| GBP | Evaluation date T+0 (most currencies T+2) affects forward-start and roll dates. Lowest BE/realised among G10 long-dated flatteners (0.00-0.89, Jan 2020), often positive carry; 15y10y/25y10y entered at -11.2bp with +0.52bp carry, closed at -19bp (+$542K). Driver: 20y richness from ALM/pension receiving. Low-vol long-end spreads give high Sharpe on small carry (12y3y/15y5y vol 3.0bp). Gilt carry uses Act/365 repo; ex-dividend accrued is negative. UK linkers on RPI, no floor. | Darbyshire, Coding Interest Rates; Citi Vol Lab (17 Jan 2020, 25 Sep 2019); Goldman Sachs desk report (30 Sep 2026); BofA linker primer (22 Jul 2025) |
| JPY | Long-end curves have the opposite slope sign; realised vol lower (2.3-3.1bp/day vs about 3.9-4.7bp elsewhere); BE/RV 0.76-1.50, JPY convexity generally expensive. Under curve control mechanical carry rules break: cross-market carry rules substitute the next-lowest-carry market. FX-hedged JGBs had the highest hedged carry in rates (Aug 2026); 1y1y receiver 3m carry about 9.6bp but strong adverse trend and R near 1 (30 Sep 2026). 2012: with the central bank on hold, forwards converge to spot and 1Y1Y receivers had the best breakeven vs roll. | Citi Vol Lab (25 Sep 2019, 17 Jan 2020); Citi regime model (12 Aug 2026); Goldman Sachs desk report; Huggins and Schaller, Fixed Income RV Analysis (2024) |
| CAD | 1y1y/2y1y/3y1y had the top vol-adjusted carry in G10 (1.47; 3m carry 11.3bp, vol 15.2) in Sep 2026 but entry and trend conflicted; BE/RV 0.45-1.82 (Jan 2020); 15y5y/20y5y BE/RV 2.00 (Sep 2019). Check leg frequency (semi-annual fixed) and the current RFR before using the fixing shortcut. | Goldman Sachs desk report (30 Sep 2026); Citi Vol Lab (17 Jan 2020, 25 Sep 2019) |
| AUD | Rising bank-bill-vs-OIS squeezes receiver carry ("caution receiving as carry squeezed out"). 3y and 10y bond futures quote 100 - yield and cash-settle against a weighted basket: EFP carry-and-roll computed per leg (swap leg: 3m-forward 2y9m swap - spot 2y9m; futures leg: futures yield - weighted basket yield, roll against a proxy basket 3m shorter). | Citi STIRT Weekly (7 Aug 2026); swapsball.net (12 Dec 2017) |
| NZD | "Steepest curve in the world (when adjusting for vol)": a carry and roll harvester and portfolio long; wary of receivers when the central bank pauses. | JWS Macro (13 Nov 2025) |
| CHF | 1y1y/2y1y ex-ante Sharpe 1.26 (7.7bp/3m carry, vol 12.3) in Sep 2026; low yielders (CHF, JPY) rally in risk-off, so carry works better in EM than in G10. | Goldman Sachs desk report; Willer and Saunders (2026) |
| SEK / NOK | Smaller forward universes in screens (to about 1y10y and 5y5y); SEK frequently had the highest 10y minus 1m carry (Mar 2017 ranking), NOK among the lowest. Bank-bill floats (3m/6m) make the fixing shortcut valid only up to that period. | Goldman Sachs desk report; J.P. Morgan European Rates Strategy (6 Mar 2017) |

## Repo and financing conventions that change carry
- Use the currency's repo day count (Act/360 for USD and EUR; Act/365 for GBP) and the settlement lag of the bond (`bond_static.settle_days`).
- Term repo (to the horizon or delivery) is the right financing for a defined-horizon trade; overnight is cheaper on a positive curve but leaves roll-over risk. The
  repo-vs-reverse spread (5.75% vs 5.55%, 20bp in one example) is a carry cost of holding both a long and a short (Conks, Demystifying the Repo Market Part III, 28 May 2024).
- A short in a special issue earns the special rate on cash, so the short leg pays (GC - special) per year; this can turn a positive-carry steepener negative. Floor
  specialness at zero in models and fall back to GC from overnight RFR fixings when specific repo is missing; do not fill with a single GC rate.
- Futures carry for when-issued or new issues uses a different, higher term repo than GC-like bonds (JPM, 28 Oct 2026).
- Negative swap spreads are not arbitrage after capital, haircut, IM and PFE; trade carry depends on the float index minus GC spread (NY Fed, Oct 2018). Swapped Treasuries
  get positive spread rolldown as they roll down the front-end spread curve (mark, not cash) (BofA, Rates basics: fixed vs float, 24 Apr 2024).
- FX-hedged carry: the FX hedge removes front-end carry, so the hedged pickup is roughly symmetric around zero (about -2% to +2% UST vs Bund). Basis-adjusted forward FX uses
  XCS-adjusted discount factors: [xccy-basis](../../xccy-basis/SKILL.md).
